decision_rule.insufficient_evidence_rule: head_roi is null (head not visible) -> uncertain
decision_rule.calibration_note: min_head_overlap_percent=10: G2 (helmet on head) overlap 20.66, G1 (no helmet) overlap 0.00, so any value between about 1 and 20 separates them. min_color_area_percent=2: only G1 constrains it (no_helmet, area 0.54, so the value must be above 0.54); G2 never reaches the area test because the overlap test fires first. No development image has a helmet held in the hand, so the upper side is untuned and 2 is a stated assumption, not a measured value.
